messages:
Alex: Thanks everyone for joining the runtime portion of today's all-hands. Recording: https://redwood.example.com/all-hands/2026/runtime. Quick follow-up: kernel v5 canary starts this week, KV cache improvements targeted for early Q2, and hosted API batching defaults will be suggested at 16 reqs/batch. Drop Qs here and we'll assign owners. TL;DR: Priya -> KV cache, Jordan -> kernel rollouts. :rocket:

Priya: Quick q — what's the rollback plan if KV cache causes quality regressions on ~1% of requests? Who owns the eval gating?

Jordan: Two-tier rollback. Immediate: traffic split -> auto-fallback to v4 variant for affected routes. Second: alerts from evals trigger auto-disable of KV cache for the canary cohort. Owners: Jordan + rollouts. Canary window: 24h with perf + quality thresholds.

Sam: For Dedicated/reserved customers who pin versions, will defaults change unexpectedly? We can't have silent defaults changing perf.

Alex: No silent forced changes for pinned Dedicated deployments. Recommendations may be pushed to Optimize, but customer-configured settings remain authoritative. Hosted default suggestions are gradual and opt-outable.

Marta: What metrics should we watch during the canary? GPU util, tail lat, and cache metrics?

Diego: +1. Dashboards: runtime.tail_p99, runtime.p95, gpu.util, kv_cache.hit_rate, kv_cache.p50_latency, kernel.queue_depth. We'll add a pre-baked "v5-canary" dashboard under Console > Runtime > Canary.

deploy-bot: canary started on cluster-alpha at 1799012360

```
canary: v5
clusters: [cluster-alpha]
percent_traffic: 5
```

Priya: Follow-up: how long before KV cache becomes opt-out/opt-in? We need an explicit filter to avoid caching sensitive inputs.

Jordan: KV cache rollout is decoupled from kernel changes. Initial plan: opt-in per-tenant, and a route-level policy "skip_cache: true" for sensitive traffic. ETA: early Q2 for broad opt-in, with policy flags available immediately for Dedicated.

Sam: Any immediate guidance for max_batch_latency tuning? Our p95 latency is critical on chat endpoints.

Alex: For latency-sensitive routes start with `max_batch_latency_ms=5`. For throughput-first routes try 20-50ms. Combine with `max_batch_tokens` to bound cost. Example config snippet: `{"max_batch_latency_ms":5,"max_batch_tokens":512}`. Monitor p95 and adjust.

Marta: Can we get a short canary abort runbook we can execute on-call? I can own the abort steps if someone writes it down.

Jordan: Will draft a concise runbook by EOD and paste here. High-level steps: 1) scale canary down to 0% traffic, 2) flip route traffic to fallback model, 3) purge KV cache entries for affected routes, 4) revert kernel deployment, 5) notify stakeholders.

Sam: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate the office hours for deeper follow-ups. 11am tomorrow works for me.

Alex: Thanks all — we'll post recording, runbook, and the canary dashboard link in #eng-runtime. Tagging owners for follow-ups: @Priya @Jordan @Marta. :eyes:
